VBO:0201050.summary: Friendly, joyful and loyal, the Medium Poodle shares the breed standard’s emphasis on learning and companionship. Poodles began as wildfowling dogs: the French name caniche comes from cane, meaning a female duck. This medium-sized variety sits between the Miniature and Standard in the FCI’s four-size system.
VBO:0201050.shortDescription: A friendly, loyal companion with wildfowling roots, in the FCI size between Miniature and Standard Poodles.

sources.title: Fédération Cynologique Internationale — Poodle standard172 (2024)
sources.evidence: Actual entire twelve-page retained FCI standard body read including history/character/anatomy/size/color/tail/clip appendix. Friendly joyful loyal companion capable of learning/training; original wildfowling role and French caniche from cane female duck. Medium Poodles over35cm through45cm; fawn includes orange/apricot. Literal rectilinear clean proportional head/muzzle9:10skull, almond dark eyes, long flat drop ears, slightly longer body, elbow-deep chest, straight parallel limbs/compact short-oval feet, high-set undocked full natural tail at ten-past-nine, never completely curled/bobtail. Elastic woolly even curls; restrained Modern clip permits body at least1cm and visible angulation without fluffy effect.

VBO:0200415.summary: Friendly and even-tempered in the breed standard, the Rabbit Smooth-haired Dachshund shares a persistent hunting focus with its larger relatives. Its nose and voice serve work below ground as well as flushing and tracking above it. Germany’s Teckel club has organized Dachshund breeding since 1888.
VBO:0200415.shortDescription: A friendly, even-tempered rabbit-sized Dachshund with the breed’s persistent hunting focus and keen nose.

sources.title: FCI Standard148 — Dachshund, all nine varieties
sources.evidence: Complete actual eleven-page FCI148 valid2021 English2022 standard read. Shared normative friendly/even temperament and passionate persistent hunting with nose; work below ground and above-ground giving tongue/flushing/tracking wounded game; DeutscheTeckelklub1888. Three sizes and three coats form nine varieties. Rabbit measured at15months: male chest27–32cm/female25–30cm. Literal smooth tight short harsh glossy coat/red black pigment,1.7–1.8 body ratio/one-third ground clearance, long strong muzzle/rounded mobile ears, complete low continuation tail slight final-third curve, full limb/paw details. No size-specific temperament or safety/health claims.
